sections_reviewed: Section 3.2 and Eq. 1 (PDF pp. 9–10): DINO/iBOT/distributed KoLeo objective
Section 4.1–4.3 and Eqs. 2–3 (pp. 11–13): patch consistency, Gram anchoring and higher-resolution teacher
title: DINOv3
summary: DINOv3 combines cross-view image-level DINO, masked-patch iBOT and distributed KoLeo, with Sinkhorn-Knopp teacher targets. Extended training can improve CLS classification while degrading patch locality. Gram anchoring preserves within-image pairwise normalized patch similarities using a separate Gram teacher, with periodic refresh and higher-resolution targets.
limits: Static visual representation learning, not a radio observation model, temporal action-conditioned world model, calibrated service-risk estimator or proof that image features identify electromagnetic state.
